Name: CC's Style Unicorns
Author: nugmods
Description:
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Hey guys! This is a bit of a different animal retexture than you may be used to from me, for one simple reason: I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21024]Unique Horses by CC.[/url] I can't imagine my Stardew without them. Now that Mizu has released her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47474]Unicorns & Friends[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47473]Horses & Ponies[/url], I want all the equines in my game to match, which leaves me with only one choice: since CC has open perms to use their sprites, clearly I need to hit them all with the CC beam.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
Also I actually had the base unicorn sprites done months ago for a personal use mod so I had these ready to go, lol.[/color][/size]

[b]Installation[/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It's a Content Patcher file, so just put it in your mods folder![/color][/size]

[b]Required Mods[/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod ONLY requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47474]Mizu's Unicorns & Friends[/url]. However...[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Recommended Mods[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21024]Unique Horses by CC[/url] - for matching, rideable horses!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8410]Donkeys[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35393]CC Style Donkeys[/url] - for matching donkeys in your barn!
Future retexture for Horses & Ponies - I'm working on this, lol[/color]

[b]Credits[/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/cajcbell/mods]Cajcbell[/url] - whose assets I used in this mod, and whose mods are a continued inspiration to me <3
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru]Mizu[/url] - for all the awesome mods I've been retexturing, including Unicorns & Friends.[/color][/size]
